name: piep-docs-tools
description: piep のドキュメント生成ツール。アプリ本体とは独立した依存を持つ。

scripts.extract: npm run extract:rust && npm run extract:front
scripts.site:dev: npm run assemble && vitepress dev site
scripts.site:build: npm run assemble && vitepress build site
scripts.docs:build: npm run contract && npm run stats && npm run rustdoc && npm run rustdoc:copy && npm run site:build
scripts.docs:check: npm run check:emphasis && npm run check:screens && npm run contract:check && npm run stats:check
scripts.docs:dev: npm run contract && npm run stats && npm run site:dev
